title: Waterproof Reflective Dog Raincoat, Sizes S to XL
bullets: Reflective, so your dog is easier to see on low-light walks.
Also snowproof, for cold and wet weather.
Available in sizes S, M, L, and XL.
description: Tired of soggy, muddy dogs after every rainy walk? This waterproof dog raincoat is made for wet days, and it is also snowproof for cold weather. The reflective design helps your dog stand out on low-light walks. The coat is made of polyester and comes in sizes S, M, L, and XL. Choose the size that fits your dog, and measure before you buy, since this page does not list chest, neck, or length measurements. The listed weight range is 57 to 94 grams. Each order includes one dog coat. Keep one by the door so it is ready for the next rainy walk. A snug fit matters most on a wet walk, so take a moment to check your dog's size. It is a practical option for dog parents who walk in all kinds of weather.

faq.a: The coat comes in sizes S, M, L, and XL. This page gives no chest, neck, or length measurements, so measure your dog and compare before you order.
It is made of polyester. It is waterproof, reflective, and snowproof.
